design: All four H949 penalties, frozen two-seed fits and task-specific discovery greedy orders. Hungarian assignment using either full symmetric product tensors or product response matrices on discovery anchors, normalized equally by task teacher response energy. Frozen assignments evaluated on full and rank1 heldout contrasts. Report selected-product agreement, amplitude disagreement and aggregate agreement; do not equate cosine with faithful amplitude.
limits: Only two seeds, known supervised tasks and repeatedly used development set. Near-zero collapsed fits are negative controls. Shared selected support does not itself establish cross-task computational reuse.
